log.msg: Opened. Usage refresh skipped: ai/usage.json is outside my write fence (the mastermind keeps it current); window.before read from the snapshot it wrote, 5% of the 5h window. Transcript endpoint Server/plugins/AILogs.js already serves Range requests and needs no change.

Built: ext/JSONL `ask` verb (merged by id like `agent` by task); ext/AITask/asks.js (Asks tab, first + default when a log carries asks) and conversation.js (the Session tab as a chat), replacing feed.js + replay.js + feed.css, which rendered the same transcript twice and read as neither. Three bugs found and fixed by measuring: `.ai-step-body { display: flex }` beat `.ai-fold-body { display: none }` at equal specificity so every fold rendered open (3,461px); `order: -1` on a wrapping flex row put the rail and the stream on separate lines (flexbox orders BEFORE it packs lines); an assistant line holding both prose and a tool call lost the tool call. Task pages now claim the `wide` track (602px -> 890px at 1280) with prose capped at --measure, the same shape core/Page uses for column prose.

log.msg: Two more defects found by looking, both silent: the prompts rail is a flex COLUMN with a max-height, so 64 prompts SHRANK to 14.6px a row instead of scrolling and every line rendered as the clipped top third of its letters (fix: flex: none on .ai-prompt); and ext/tabs sets --measure: none on .tab-panel, so the new prose cap resolved to none and did nothing - paragraphs measured 858px at 1280 with the rule matching and the browser reporting max-width: none (fix: .ai-task .tab-panel { --measure: 40em }, scoped).

Measured at 400/1280/1920/3440, no overflow at any width. Gestures proven headless: card click opens the detail in place with no url change; 'the prompt' switches to Session and lights the message at top 0; a tool-run fold opens and renders 97 raw blocks; ?m=<uuid> opens Session lit on a cold load. Regression: 2026-09-13/page-cms renders 64 turns, 64 rail prompts, 83 folds, none open, no console errors; a task whose transcript is gone still says 'served by the dev server only'.

assign.outcome:
**The AI log now shows what you asked for, as preview cards, linked to the sentence you said it in.**

[**The Asks tab**](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/mastermind-layout-browser/) is the first tab on this run's page and opens by default: thirteen cards, one per thing you asked for, each a title, one line, a status chip and `n of m tasks landed` counted from the serving tasks' own logs. Click a card and the detail opens **in place** under the wall - your words verbatim, then each serving task's outcome and every line of its log, with the ones that read as a decision accented. Nothing navigates; nothing is on the first screen that does not have to be.

![the Asks tab at 1280](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/ai-log-asks/asks-1280.jpg)

[**The prompt**](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/mastermind-layout-browser/?m=534b8723-d1a1-4eab-a4b6-c1b3a8138351) on every card opens the Session tab at that message. That tab is now a **conversation**: your messages as white cards, Claude's replies as plain prose, and every run of tool calls folded to one grey line - *"thought, loaded 2 skills, ran 22 commands, edited 10 files, spawned 6 agents"* - that opens on click. A rail of every message you sent runs down the left; clicking one scrolls there. [A long one reads well](/framework/ai/2026-09-13/page-cms/): 64 messages, 83 folded runs, none open.

Under it: a new `ask` verb in [ext/JSONL](/framework/ext/JSONL/doc/task-jsonl/) that merges by id the way `agent` merges by task, and one `conversation.js` replacing `feed.js` and `replay.js`, which had been rendering the same transcript twice in two shapes on one tab. Design record: [doc/asks.md](/framework/ext/AITask/doc/asks/).

**Left, with reasons.** The asks wall is about a third taller than one screen at 1280 - three legible 287px cards beat four cramped 208px ones, and at 1920 and 3440 it is one screen. Which log lines count as decisions is a keyword guess; it only ever accents a line, never hides one, and an explicit flag would be a schema change nobody has asked for. The conversation still polls the transcript rather than streaming it, because the transcript lives outside the repo and the dev server does not watch it.
